messages:
maria: Quick brief  can we produce a lightweight "bench provenance" asset bundle for launch comms? Needs: 3 tiles (latency / cost / quality) + 16:9 explainer slide + 600x200 email header + small inbound-routing CSV. Mobile-first. Deadline: Fri EOD.
kevin: Understood. Do you want the tiles to include a micro-panel for per-token cost (relative only) and a unified sparkline?
maria: Yes to both. Sparkline style should be consistent; use different accent colors per metric. Cost values must be relative (no $) and labeled p95.
tara: Palette question  brand navy + coral works, but I'll validate AA contrast on 12px labels. If it's marginal we'll switch to accent orange.
frank: I'll draft 3 short headlines + 2 CTA variants for A/B test and a 1-line methodology blurb for the slide footer. Will include a translation context column.
legal: Reminder: avoid absolute claims like "fastest" or "cheapest." Use terms such as "latency-optimized" or "cost-efficient." Any metric comparisons need a citation and methodology footnote. Also confirm alt text is included for each asset.
l10n: For FR/JA, please provide a CSV of strings with a context column and character limits. CTAs should be <=18 chars.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-6789 "bench-provenance-pack". Assigned: @kevin, @tara. Due 2025-07-04. Exports requested: PNG tiles (600x600), mobile crop (320x180), email hero 600x200, slide 1920x1080, SVG icon set, GIF ~2s, strings CSV, inbound-routing CSV.
kevin: I'll start the Figma with tokens and an asset manifest. Starter link: https://figma.com/file/bench-provenance-6789. Will include separate copy layers and accessible alt text sheets.
maria: Also include a tiny inbound microflow graphic for the slide (signup -> confirm -> nurture -> webinar -> demo). Keep to 5 nodes max and simple icons. Add an asset manifest listing filenames and intended uses.
tara: Plan: deliver static PNGs, animated GIF for social, slide export, and SVG pack. First pass available Thu 4pm PT.
frank: Methodology draft: "p95 latency measured on standard gen workloads with default batching; cost normalized to baseline. See methodology doc for details." I'll add the link in the slide footer.
legal: I'll review copy once the first pass is uploaded. Please avoid superlative language; provide explicit labels (p95/p50) for metrics.
maria: Thanks team  this set feeds webinar slides, launch social, and inbound email flows. Ping when first pass is up for a quick 15-min review. :rocket:
